notes.notes:
Hello.
We have released an update to "Enjoy the Diner" on April 11, 2024.
By applying this update, we have added new Korean language support.

We hope you will continue to enjoy this game.
Thanks!

notes.title: Vote for "Enjoy the Diner" as a Steam Award nominee!
notes.notes:
The end of the year is finally approaching.
And, It is time for the Steam Awards again this year. The nominees for the awards will receive even more prestige than they already have. Of course, we are well aware that the reality is that the Steam Awards are only given to the most talked about and biggest titles of the year, but if you don't participate, you won't get the results you deserve.

So, if you enjoyed Enjoy the Diner, why not vote for this film's nomination? We have chosen " Outstanding Story-Rich Game Award" as a feature of this work to guide our voting, but we hope that all players will choose the item they think is best.

Thank you for your continued support of "Enjoy the Diner".

notes.title: Update on November 21, 2023
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Enjoy the Diner.

An update was released on November 21, 2023. By applying this update,
The following features will be added.

[b]Piano mode has been added.[/b]
A piano solo mode has been added to the BGM, a major feature of this title.
The BGM can be switched between normal BGM and piano BGM by pressing the keyboard icon on the settings screen.

[b]Added text display mode[/b]
In addition to the normal text window and window + subtitle,
In addition to the normal text window and window + subtitle, we have added a mode that displays only subtitles.
This mode is recommended for those who want to immerse themselves in the world without text on the game screen.

Thanks!

notes.title: アップデート＆新サントラ発売のお知らせ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/5638fb6bae247695de920a493e7e01ce1d2ed627.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Enjoy the Diner.
Today we are pleased to announce the release of our new soundtrack "Enjoy the Diner: Piano Sound track" as well as a few updates.

[b]About Enjoy the Diner:  Piano Soundtrack[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677060/

Today we released the product page for the new soundtrack for Enjoy the Diner.
Enjoy the Diner: Piano Soundtrack" features seven fantastic pieces of background music that transport players to the Moon Palace, re-edited for solo piano accompaniment. The piano soundtrack offers a slightly sad and humorous atmosphere that can only be enjoyed with the sound of the piano.

[b]About Enjoy the Diner update[/b]
The piano solo version of the BGM can actually be heard in the game by applying the update patch for the main game. You can also listen to it in the "Sound Gallery" which is unlocked after clearing the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/c092552b941d52a6368c1c52f291ddb9cba9e6e2.jpg[/img]
The text display method has also been modified. Three text display patterns are available: "Text Window" (default), "Subtitle and Text Window", and "Subtitle". By selecting "Subtitle" only, you can immerse yourself in the game without displaying a text window in each scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/4566859e024d2d46a1ffe6b69dcf6d0e68de310c.jpg[/img]
The "Enjoy the Diner" update is scheduled to be released simultaneously with "Enjoy the Diner: Piano Soundtrack". The scheduled release date is November 29th (Pacific Time), two weeks from today.

We hope you enjoy both the soundtrack and the update.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update on August 10, 2023 (bug fixes)
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Thank you for playing "Enjoy the Diner".
An update was released on August 10, 2023.
This update fixes the following bugs.

[b] 1. fixed a bug that the game did not start if the OS was in a certain language.[/b]
As an example, we fixed a problem in which the game would not start if the language setting on the Windows side was French. This was due to the decimal point being written differently in some languages than in Japan or the United States. 

[b]2. fixed a bug in which the conditions for obtaining some Steam achievements were incorrect[/b]
For a few hours at the time of release, there was a bug that when you acquired the "Possible" achievement, you could also acquire the "Accidental? was also obtained at the same time. This has been completely fixed in this update.

Please continue to enjoy "Enjoy the Diner" :)

Thanks!

notes.title: Update on August 1, 2023 (bug fixes)
notes.notes:
Hi there,

We are sorry for the quick update right after the launch day.
For those playing in Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), there was a bug that prevented progress in some routes. If you are playing in other languages, there is no problem, and save data in all languages is unaffected. 

We hope you continue to enjoy your stay in the Moon palace.

Thanks!

[h3]【ファミレスを享受せよ とは？】[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/3a606b54fdef3e6f750b31384d633b960b1815cd.jpg[/img]

"Enjoy the Diner" was released in 2022 and was well received by adventure and novel game fans. WakuWaku Games has changed the development environment of this game and added gallery elements and chats with each of the characters, which fans of this game will enjoy a little more.  

Arranged for easier playability with controller and full-screen support. We have created a new complete version of the game to meet the expectations of fans who have already played the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/e89daf047d7373a5ad2647c8cf5166e408cc4edc.jpg[/img]

The game is an adventure game with command selection and partial point-and-click system. Trapped in the eternal family restaurant "Moon Palace," you will spend endless hours adapting to the mysterious space of Moon Palace through conversations with those who have wandered in before you. Will you be able to return safely to your original world? All the elements that make up the game, such as the unique atmosphere and colorful visuals reminiscent of retro games, memorable characters, and a slightly mysterious story, won the hearts of game fans who played the original version when it was first released.

notes.title: Enjoy the Diner launches August 1
notes.notes:
Hi there,
We are happy to announce today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/5638fb6bae247695de920a493e7e01ce1d2ed627.png[/img]

Since the release of Enjoy the Diner in 2022, we have received a lot of support from game fans, and we are proud to be able to release the full version of the game on Steam. Once again, We really appreciate your support.

The Steam version adds a gallery element and a bit of talk between each of the characters that fans of the game will appreciate. The game has also been rearranged for easier play with controller and full-screen support. The game has been reworked to meet the expectations of fans who have already played the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/991f4be430866496e9651f40526ef3bd8b43c952.jpg[/img]

Working with the author, Monthly Wetland Oississui, and Studio Dragonet, who was in charge of the production, we are pleased to announce the date when we can finally deliver it to you.

[b]The game will be launched on Tuesday, August 1.
A soundtrack will be released at the same time along with the main game![/b]

We have received comments on this announcement from two people involved in the production.

[b]Monthly Wetland : Oississui[/b]
It was a really nice play experience.
I think I painted more pictures in the illustration gallery of the clear bonus than I did in the main game.
It is nice to play at night. Best regards.

[b]Studio Dragonet: Jun Sekiya[/b]
I had played "Enjoy the Diner" before I was asked to port it.
I was thinking that it would be difficult for me to create such an emo game,
I am very honored to be involved in the development of this game.
I made every effort to ensure that both those who have played this game before and those who have not can enjoy "Enjoy the Families".
Please enjoy the eternal Moon Palace!

 Please also take advantage of our wish list registration to be notified when the game is available.

notes.title: Development note (June 13)
notes.notes:
Hello there,

The Steam version of "Enjoy the Diner" is currently in production for release this summer. Full screen support, English and Chinese language support, additional chats, gallery mode, etc, We are working day and night to provide you with a fuller and richer version of the game.

So, We are pleased to present a few screenshots of the Steam version of the game as a progress report.

Controller is now supported! Of course, You can play with a mouse or a keyboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/69f280e90fbb542f40815a25eaedbd824f8a8d6c.jpg[/img]

Everyone's favorite drink fountain. You can drink with one button / key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/2750aafda003060e88aec6527b02b3378f0b4010.jpg[/img]

You can also enjoy it in Chinese.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/5b2c87dd75665005b47647a60433f454451bc02a.jpg[/img]

A settings mode has also been created.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134275/af452fdb42838931916cd1e4faa1f2d5a4c91c20.jpg[/img]

It will be a while before it is released,
Under the supervision of Gekkan Shicchitai / Oisissui, The atmosphere of the original version will be maintained, Please stay tuned for further updates on the new "Enjoy the Diner".
